answer: Water agents earn one release vote only after testing a terrace valve during one common canyon trial. The registry admits a key with two steward signatures over that key, its valve and trial ID. A steward gets one booking per trial, so aliases cannot share signers or let a test wander into a later slot. One honest key needs 2 bookings. A farm seeking 1,000 votes needs 2,000 simultaneous bookings from the fixed steward roster. Bribery can buy existing bookings, and honest agents must arrange two stewards in advance. The rule depends on a registry that prevents double booking.
